run_query_stream: run the query function to stream chat completions from a Hugging Face LLM model
create_query_generator: create a generator function that yields JSON chunks from an SSE stream response
build_llm_chat_request: build a POST request to the Hugging Face chat completions API with streaming enabled
test_query_function: test the query function with a user message payload and model parameter
summarize_stream_chunks: summarize the streamed response chunks by printing delta content from each chunk
